summary: Generation Essentials Group, a NYSE- and LSE-listed French-headquartered media and hospitality company, furnished a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 carrying unaudited interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue from contracts with customers rose 35.8% to US$30.8 million, hospitality revenue climbed 59.8%, net profit reached US$22.8 million and EPS US$0.56, with total assets of US$1.8 billion and net asset value of US$932.5 million. The filing recaps four completed hotel acquisitions and a new Macao L'Officiel coffee venue; no new transaction, terms, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed, so the report is a routine earnings update rather than a special situation, with the only watch item being disclosure quality ahead of the referenced post-effective F-3 amendment.
